title: PanoHelper
description: A very small pack to help people make panoramas
body:
# Panorama Helper
## What does it do?
Helps give a simple template to create Minecraft menu panoramas that are in the correct order.

Each face of the cube is labeled so you always know where each face of your own panorama should go
## What are the faces
`assets\minecraft\textures\gui\title\background\panorama_0` 

through

`assets\minecraft\textures\gui\title\background\panorama_3` 

are the horizontal sides of the cube, in clockwise order.
### .

`assets\minecraft\textures\gui\title\background\panorama_5` :

is the bottom face (which is generally always visible)
### .

`assets\minecraft\textures\gui\title\background\panorama_4` :

is the top face (which is generally not always visible)
## Compatibility
The pack works for all versions as of upload that have allowed resource packs, since whenever minecraft added resource packs they haven't changed where the panos are (from at the very least of Minecraft 1.6)

## Contact Me:
Any problems, questions, help:
https://discord.gg/4ta7pM4bnr
Let me know if there are any more incompatibilities in my discord!
